issues.text: Whether the criminal proceedings' length and conduct impacted the overall length of the civil proceedings under the reasonable time requirement

anchor.surface_text: The civil proceedings were initiated on 17 May 1983 and ended on 15 November 1998. The proceedings in total thus lasted almost fifteen years and six months. The intervening criminal proceedings, which began on 3 August 1983 and ended with the Court of Cassation's rejection of the applicant's request for leave to appeal on 7 June 1994, cannot be the subject of a separate complaint under Article 6. However, given the impact of the length of the criminal proceedings on the overall length of the civil proceedings, the Court will have regard to the manner in which the criminal proceedings were conducted from the standpoint of the reasonable-time requirement.
